hook: SonicWall’s VPN MFA bypass is being exploited — plus 4 more

items.claim: SonicWall’s SSL‑VPN MFA bypass flaw (CVE‑2026‑19868) is being exploited
Hackers exploit Plex2Shell chain in Plex Media Server to compromise QNAP NAS devices
319 malicious Chrome extensions hijacked searches, with an estimated 13.4 million installs over a decade
Chrome 157 update patches 213 security issues, seven of them critical
Hackers stole credentials and live tokens for every Chainalysis customer

caption: Your devices face many threats, from VPN logins to browser extensions. Which risk scares you more, the VPN MFA bypass or the Chrome search hijack?
alt_text: Five slides list security threats: SonicWall VPN MFA bypass exploited, QNAP NAS breach via Plex2Shell, 319 malicious Chrome extensions with an estimated 13.4 million installs, Chrome 157 fixing 213 issues, and Chainalysis credential theft.
